name: tinytick
title: Tinytick
description: Manage TickTick tasks from the launcher over the TickTick web API. No desktop app needed.
author: mimukit

commands.name: today
commands.title: Today
commands.subtitle: TickTick
commands.description: Today's TickTick tasks, with keyboard actions for date, priority and completion.

commands.name: quick-add
commands.title: Quick Add Task
commands.subtitle: TickTick
commands.description: Add a TickTick task in natural language with a live preview.

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.subtitle: TickTick
commands.description: Add a TickTick task in one line from the root search.

commands.name: sync
commands.title: Sync
commands.subtitle: TickTick
commands.description: Refresh the local TickTick cache from the server.

commands.name: lists
commands.title: Lists
commands.subtitle: TickTick
commands.description: Browse TickTick lists and open one.

commands.name: completed
commands.title: Completed Tasks
commands.subtitle: TickTick
commands.description: TickTick tasks completed in a date range.

commands.name: account
commands.title: Account
commands.subtitle: TickTick
commands.description: Sign in to TickTick, sign out, and see the sync state.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Today Count
commands.subtitle: TickTick
commands.description: Overdue and today task count in the menu bar, read from the local cache.

preferences.name: refreshAge
preferences.title: Refresh on open
preferences.description: Refresh in the background when the cache is older than this.

preferences.name: prefill
preferences.title: Quick Add pre-fill
preferences.description: Text to put in Quick Add when it opens.

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: OAuth client ID
preferences.description: Client ID of your own TickTick developer app, for browser sign-in. Leave empty to use an API token.

preferences.name: oauthRedirect
preferences.title: OAuth redirect
preferences.description: The redirect URI registered in your TickTick developer app.

preferences.name: safeUpdates
preferences.title: Safe edits
preferences.label: Fetch a task before each edit
preferences.description: Turn on if TickTick drops fields on a partial update.

preferences.name: enableV2
preferences.title: Unofficial v2 API
preferences.label: Use the TickTick web API for extras
preferences.description: One-call sync, Won't Do, pin and subtask links. Needs a session cookie from the Account command. Unofficial and can break.
